<!-- One source per pull request. CONTRIBUTING.md has the shape and a worked example. -->

**Source added or changed:** `sources/...`

**What it does to the record** (tick one):
- [ ] Supports an existing figure (added to its `sources`)
- [ ] Changes a figure (with a `history` entry)
- [ ] Evidence against a figure (added to `considered`, with the reason)
- [ ] A new finding
- [ ] No figure change (wording, typo, vocabulary)

**How you read it:** at source, or through someone else's account (`access: secondary`)?

**Do you have an interest in this figure?** (Your employer sells something it affects, for example.)
